data.gender_notes: Farhaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'farh', meaning 'to bring forth, to cause to appear, to make light'. The name Farhaa refers to a luminous and radiant being, shining with the light of faith and wisdom. The name Farhaa carries the meaning “Light, Radiance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farhaa usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farhaa total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
